blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval produce market stall constructed from warm brown timber posts and planks. It features an arched red-and-cream striped canvas awning over a main counter, with wooden crates and a woven bowl displaying fruits and vegetables (carrots, green cabbages, pumpkins, apples/tomatoes, and purple roots). Two additional angled wooden crates rest on the ground in front, holding red fruit and green cabbages. Geometry is solid, clean, and hand-painted with no disconnected, jagged, or melted parts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular red-and-cream striped awning framed by wooden posts and a ridge beam, with two small wooden produce crates visible protruding at the bottom edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4.5 to 5 ft tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 ft wide.
